items.title: 歌舞路サイファー
items.artist: MC 夜風 & ザ・ネオン・クルー
items.caption: Late 1980s Japanese city pop fused with old-school hip hop. The verses are rapped in Japanese by a relaxed, confident male MC with a deep voice; the chorus is sung by a sweet, clear female vocalist with soft harmonies. Punchy drum machine boom-bap beat with a crisp snare and swung hi-hats, funky slap bass, bright Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy major seventh chords, clean chorus-effect rhythm guitar, horn section stabs, vinyl record scratches between phrases. Cool, stylish, neon nightlife in the big city. Warm analog tape production.

朝が来るまで 踊りつづけて

[Verse 2 - Rap]

高架の上を 最終が走る
コンビニの前で 缶コーヒー開けて
仲間が集まる 輪になって
誰かが刻めば 誰かが返す

歌舞路サイファー

items.title: 湾岸フロウ
items.caption: Japanese city pop and AOR blended with smooth early 1990s hip hop. Laid-back male rap verses in Japanese, low and conversational; a silky male falsetto sings the chorus with layered harmonies. Mid-tempo head-nodding drum machine groove, deep round synth bass, glassy digital electric piano, clean chorus-effect guitar licks, shimmering synth pads, a smooth alto saxophone answering the vocal. A night drive on the bayside expressway, cool sea air, city lights sliding past. Polished, glossy studio production.

items.title: 終電フリースタイル
items.artist: ミッドナイト・キャンディ
items.caption: Late 1980s Japanese pop with a new jack swing beat and playful rap. A bright, cheeky young woman raps the verses in Japanese with bounce and attitude, and sings the catchy chorus herself with girl-group backing vocals. Swinging drum machine with hard snare hits and shuffled hi-hats, punchy synth bass, orchestra hit stabs, bright synth brass, funky clean guitar, handclaps. Fun, energetic, a night out in the city after missing the last train. Glossy digital studio production.

items.title: ヨルマート午前三時
items.caption: Mellow jazzy hip hop with a Japanese city pop mood, intimate and late-night. A low, unhurried male voice raps in Japanese, almost speaking, close to the microphone; a soft female voice sings the short hook. Dusty, laid-back boom-bap drums with brushed hi-hats, warm upright bass, mellow Rhodes electric piano chords, a muted trumpet drifting in and out, vinyl crackle. Lonely but warm, a convenience store glowing on an empty street at three in the morning.
items.lyrics:

A glamorous, smoky female lead vocal sings the verses and chorus in Japanese; midway through, a smooth male MC raps a verse in Japanese over the groove. Four-on-the-floor disco-funk drums with handclaps, driving slap bass, scratchy rhythm guitar, sparkling electric piano, lush string synthesizer, bright horn section riffs. Glamorous, bittersweet, strangers dancing close in a neon-lit club. Warm analog tape sound.

items.title: 恵比寿島ナイト
items.caption: Hard-hitting late 1980s funk rap with a Japanese city pop gloss. An energetic male MC raps in Japanese with a punchy, rhythmic delivery, and a crew shouts the chorus together in call and response. Heavy drum machine beat with a booming kick and a cracking snare, growling synth bass, sharp funk guitar, synth brass riffs, record scratches, a talk box melody. Tough, exciting, street racers gathering in a floodlit parking area by the bay at night. Loud, punchy production.

items.title: Tōto City Lights
items.caption: Smooth early 1990s hip hop built on a Japanese city pop groove. A laid-back male MC raps the verses in English with a warm, storytelling flow; a sweet female vocalist sings the chorus in English. Head-nodding boom-bap drums, round melodic bass, jazzy Rhodes electric piano chords, soft string pads, a clean chorus-effect guitar lick, mellow saxophone fills, light vinyl scratches. Nostalgic, romantic, a stranger falling for a neon city at night. Warm, polished production.
items.lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah. Toto after dark.

[Verse 1 - Rap]
Stepped off the last train, neon in the rain
A city full of strangers and nobody knows my name
Red dragon on the tower watching over the crossing
Taxi lights are flowing like a river, never stopping
Got a pocket full of change and a head full of dreams
Nothing in this town is ever quite what it seems
Smoke curling slow from a basement bar
Somebody's saxophone sounds like a falling star
I walk the back alleys where the lanterns glow
Every door's a story that I'm dying to know
The night's still young and the streets are wide
So I turn my collar up and I let the rhythm ride

[Chorus - Sung]
Toto city lights, shining on me
Every color of the night is all I see
Toto city lights, don't let me go
Hold me till the morning in your neon glow

[Verse 2 - Rap]
Midnight on the bayside, windows rolled down
Radio is humming with that city pop sound
Ferris wheel is turning pink and blue on the water
Engine purring low and the summer night's getting hotter
She said, where you from? I said, far from here
She laughed and poured another, said, you'll stay a year
Now the bridges and the towers feel a little like home
Even when I'm walking through the small hours alone
Sunrise creeping over the old town roofs
Vending machine coffee and some worn-out shoes
I came here for a weekend, now I can't say goodbye
This city's got a hold on me and I don't ask why

[Chorus - Sung]
Toto city lights, shining on me
Every color of the night is all I see
Toto city lights, don't let me go
Hold me till the morning in your neon glow

[Instrumental Break - Saxophone Solo]

[Chorus - Sung]
Toto city lights, shining on me
Every color of the night is all I see
Toto city lights, don't let me go
Hold me till the morning in your neon glow

[Outro]

items.title: 電光ブレイクス
items.caption: Mid-1980s electro-funk and hip hop instrumental with a Japanese city pop flavour. A hard drum machine breakbeat with a booming kick, handclaps and cowbell, a squelchy analog synth bass line, bright city pop chord stabs on a digital electric piano, rhythmic vinyl record scratching as the lead, arcade game bleeps, a soaring analog synthesizer solo. Energetic, futuristic, an electric town of neon signs and game arcades. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.title: 雨の交差点
items.caption: Melancholy Japanese city pop ballad crossed with slow, soulful hip hop. A soft-spoken woman raps the verses in Japanese, gentle and wistful, then sings the aching chorus with airy harmonies. Slow, heavy boom-bap drums, warm fretless bass, mellow Rhodes electric piano, lush string synthesizer pads, a lonely saxophone. Bittersweet, rain on a neon crossing late at night, thinking of someone who is gone. Smooth analog studio sound.

items.title: 朝までブギー
items.artist: 東都ブギー・エクスプレス
items.caption: Upbeat early 1980s disco-rap party record in a Japanese city pop style. A cheerful male MC and a sassy female MC trade rapped lines in Japanese in a bouncy old-school party flow, and everyone sings the chorus together. Four-on-the-floor drums with handclaps and congas, bouncing slap bass, scratchy funk rhythm guitar, bright horn section riffs, sparkling electric piano, a cheering crowd. Joyful, glamorous, a dance floor that doesn't stop until morning. Warm analog tape sound.

items.title: B面の夜
items.caption: Mellow instrumental hip hop made from Japanese city pop. A slow, dusty boom-bap drum loop with a lazy swing, warm round bass, dreamy Rhodes electric piano playing lush major seventh chords, a looped clean guitar phrase with chorus effect, soft string pads, a wistful soprano saxophone melody, gentle vinyl crackle and occasional record scratches. Relaxed, nostalgic, cruising slowly through the sleeping city. Instrumental, no vocals.
